dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! <$pkcry;1(1,2)>!
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,9)>Ugh, what’s up with me lately? I can’t make any flames.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! <$pkcry;1(1,2)>!
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,9)>Ugh, o que há comigo ultimamente? Eu não posso fazer nenhuma chama.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>You havin’ some trouble, pal? I wouldn’t know what
that’s like—I’m always in rare form!
<$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,9)>Check this out: BAM! FLAMES! Anytime, anywhere, I can
just BWOOSH! You see that? <$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,8)>BWOOOSH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Você está tendo algum problema, amigo? Eu não saberia o que
isso é como – Eu estou sempre em forma rara!
<$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,9)>Veja isto: BAM! FLAMES! A qualquer hora, em qualquer lugar, eu posso
está a ver aquilo? <$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,8)>BWOOOSH!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Hmph... It’s not THAT impressive...<$comcan(1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)> CYNDAAA!!!
<$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>It’s no use. I’m never gonna make fire on my own... *sniffle*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Hmph... Não é QUE impressionante...<$comcan(1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)> CYNDAAA!!!
<$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Não adianta. Eu nunca vou fazer fogo em meu próprio ... *sniffle *

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Maybe you’re just tryin’ too hard, y’know? Here, take a
deep breath and try lettin’ go of that frustration. Relaaax.
<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>OK, now try again.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Talvez você está apenas tentando’ muito difícil, você sabe? Aqui, tomar um
Respire fundo e tente soltar a frustração. Relaaax.
<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>Ok, agora tenta outra vez.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,6)>Like this?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,6)>Assim?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah, that’s the stuff! Now try to do one big BWOOOSH!<wait(0.4)><$motion(1,850)><wait(1.2)>
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Sim, isso é o material! Agora tente fazer um grande BWOOOSH!<wait(0.4)><$motion(1,850)><wait(1.2)>

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>It worked! IT WORKED! Wow, thanks a bunch, <$cdef(27)>Quilava</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Funcionou! Uau, muito obrigado. <$cdef(27)>Quilava</color>!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Ha! Don’t mention it.
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,5)>Your flames still look pretty puny, though. Better keep
practicin’ if you wanna spit fire like me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Ha! Não mencione isso.
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,5)>Mas as tuas chamas ainda parecem muito fracas.
Praticar’ se você quiser cuspir fogo como eu!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>GRRR! Just you wait—soon I’m gonna make WAY bigger
flames than you ever could!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>GRRR! Basta esperar - em breve eu vou fazer muito maior
As chamas do que tu alguma vez conseguiste!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>...But then this HUGE tree came crashing down! I was
stuck, so I decided to use a move that—
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? *sniff sniff*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas então esta árvore HUGE caiu!
Fiquei preso, por isso decidi usar um movimento que...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>*Sniff sniff *

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>What is it?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>O que foi?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I just caught a whiff of a real good smell. Is someone
bakin’ bread nearby?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Acabei de sentir um cheiro muito bom. É alguém?
pão de bakin’ próximo?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>Bread? I don’t smell anything like that...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>Pão? Eu não cheiro nada assim...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>No, I’m definitely picking up on a bready smell!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>It’s gettin’ stronger! *sniff sniff* Wait, it’s coming from...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>Não, eu definitivamente estou captando um cheiro de pão!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Está ficando mais forte! *Cheiro de cheiro* Espere, está vindo de...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Coming from...?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Vindo de...?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)><$textsize(2)>From YOU, <$cdef(27)>Dachsbun</color>!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)><$textsize(2)>De VOCÊ, <$cdef(27)>Dachsbun</color>!</textsize>

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Is it? Oh, silly me! I should have realized.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Well, I’m glad we sorted that out. Please continue your
story... <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Quilava?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>- Devia ter percebido.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Bem, eu estou feliz que resolvemos isso. Por favor, continue o seu
História... <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Quilava?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Y’know, ya look a lot like bread, too, <$cdef(27)>Dachsbun... And
maybe you’d taste like bread if I took a bite outta ya...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Você sabe, você se parece muito com pão, também, <$cdef(27)>Dachsbun... E...
talvez você teria gosto de pão se eu dei uma mordida de você ...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>Quilava, you must be hungry. Why don’t I go and find
a nice berry for you, hm?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, Oh, <$cdef(27)>Quilava, você deve estar com fome. Por que eu não vou e encontrar
Uma bela fruta para ti, hum?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>*stare*...
It’s floating...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>*stare*...
Está flutuando...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Has my little flower caught your eye? Well, this little one
is quite shy. <$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Stare at it too long and...see?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>A minha flor chamou-te a atenção?
é bastante tímido. <$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Olha para ele muito tempo e... vê?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Wha—?! Whoa!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>O quê?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh dear. I told you it was shy. Seems it hid itself away!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu disse-te que era tímido, parece que se escondeu.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Huh?! How—?! What’d you do?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>O que você fez?!!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>Me? Why, I didn’t do a thing.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>Eu? Por que, eu não fiz nada.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Yeah right! There’s gotta be some kinda trick to it. You got
psychic powers? Maybe ya teleported it or somethin’?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Sim, certo! Deve haver algum tipo de truque para ele.
poderes psíquicos? Talvez você teletransportou ou algo assim?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Perhaps...but then again, perhaps not. Who can say? Good
luck trying to figure it out. <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>Hee hee... ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Talvez... mas talvez não.
Sorte a tentar descobrir. <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>Hee hee...

dialogues.en: <$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Awww, c’mon! This is gonna drive me CRAZY!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Awww, vamos lá! Isso vai me deixar louco!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Rookidee</color>! What’s wrong?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Rookidee</color>O que há de errado?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I wish I could fly way, WAY higher than I can right now...
But how can I do that?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Quem me dera poder voar muito mais alto do que agora...
Mas como posso fazer isso?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, that’s an EASY fix! Just leave it to me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, isso é uma solução fácil! Basta deixá-lo comigo!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? Really?! But uh... What are you gonna do?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas o que vais fazer?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Hehe, aaall will become clear! Just hold on a second!
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>HYUP! <$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,10)>HRAH! HYAAAA!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Espera um segundo!
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>HYUP! <$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,10)>HyAAAA!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, WOW! You’re REALLY strong! But why are you doing
that all of a sudden?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Nossa! Você é realmente forte! Mas por que você está fazendo
Isso de repente?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>This is my tried-and-true warm-up for just about anything!
I gotta get all PUMPED UP if I’m gonna send you FLYIN’!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Este é o meu aquecimento de verdade para quase tudo!
Eu tenho que ficar todo pumped up se eu vou enviar-lhe FLYIN’!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Er, you don’t mean you’re gonna... I mean... With that
hammer...?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Er, você não quer dizer que você vai ... Quero dizer ... Com isso
Martelo...?

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Yup! I’m gonna launch ya WAAAY up into the sky!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Yup! Eu vou lançar você WAAAY para o céu!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Uhhhhhh, you know what, I, um—I’m suddenly feeling
scared of heights! Really, REALLY scared!
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>So sorry, but maybe next time!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Uhhhhhh, você sabe o que, eu, hum-eu estou sentindo de repente
Realmente, muito assustado!
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>Desculpa, mas talvez da próxima vez!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,7)>Awww... For real?! Well, OK, but you know who to call if
you ever change your mind!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,7)>Awww... De verdade?! Bem, OK, mas você sabe a quem chamar se
Alguma vez mudaste de ideias!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)>Mrooow... I feel all twitchy.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)>Srooow... sinto-me todo nervoso.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>What’s the matter, <$cdef(27)>Sprigatito</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Qual é o problema, <$cdef(27)>Sprigatito</color>?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Espeon, whenever I see your tail...my whole body gets all
itchy and twitchy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Espeon, Sempre que vejo a tua cauda... todo o meu corpo fica todo
Coceira e tique!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,51)>That’s a little, ah, concerning...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,51)>Isso é um pouco, ah, preocupante...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,5)><wait(0.5)><$motionoff(1,644)>Sprrrowr!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,5)><wait(0.5)><$motionoff(1,644)>Sprrowr!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Goodness, that was a close one! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Meu Deus, essa foi por pouco!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,58)>Um, I’m sorry! I just can’t help it! Your tail <$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>makes me
wanna grab it SO BAD...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(1,644)>Sprrrowr-rowrrr!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,58)>Um, eu sinto muito! Eu só não posso ajudá-lo! Sua cauda <$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>me faz
Quero agarrar-te tão mal...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(1,644)>Sprrrowr-rowrrr!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Oh dear, you almost had it that time!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Meu Deus, quase o apanhaste dessa vez!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Awww... You knew JUST where I was gonna pounce!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Awww... Você sabia exatamente onde eu ia atacar!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>The full moon the other night was truly stunning to behold.
It reminded me of the jewel on your forehead.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>A lua cheia na outra noite foi realmente deslumbrante de se ver.
Lembrou-me da jóia na tua testa.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Is that so? How lovely... I would have liked to see it myself.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Que adorável... eu gostaria de vê-lo eu mesmo.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>The night breeze is cool and comforting. Would you like to
stay up late with me tonight to feel it?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>A brisa da noite é fresca e reconfortante. Gostaria de
Ficar acordado até tarde comigo esta noite para senti-lo?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Yes, that could be nice every once in a while.
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>While we’re on the subject, why don’t you try waking up
early? I have so much I’d like to show you, too.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Like how the flowers glisten as the sun begins to rise...
The way the light bounces off their petals is a thing of
exquisite splendor.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Sim, isso podia ser bom de vez em quando.
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Enquanto estamos no assunto, por que você não tenta acordar
cedo? Eu tenho tanto que eu gostaria de mostrar-lhe, também.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Como as flores brilham quando o sol começa a nascer...
A forma como a luz salta das suas pétalas é uma coisa de
Magnífico esplendor.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah yes, I would imagine their beauty is quite unlike that of
the swaying flowers beneath the moon’s light.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah sim, eu imagino que a beleza deles é completamente diferente daquela de
as flores oscilantes sob a luz da lua.

just
discussing
some
beautiful
scenery
we’ve seen.

discussão

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>A sea of sparkling stars... How splendid! That sounds like
an ideal setting for an all-night soiree.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Um mar de estrelas cintilantes... que esplêndido!
Um cenário ideal para uma festa de noite.

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>The night has many wondrous offerings.

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>A blue sky... Why does that make me feel nostalgic?
